eligibility.BankSim: Daily time; missing MCC/channel/status; needs separate model.
eligibility.IBM: Native supported schema; synthetic, same source as fitting.
eligibility.IEEE-CIS: Anonymized predictors; cannot directly substitute app inputs.
eligibility.Sparkov: Unsupported without channel/MCC/status assumptions; sensitivity only.

label_boundary: Adapters exclude target/scenario fields. Save prediction hashes before computing any transfer metrics. Do not fit or calibrate afterward.
purpose: Test other generators/patterns; never tune on these results.
scenario_scope: Previously exposed, author-supplied scenarios, not bank truth.
sparkov_assumptions: MCC0000 unknown; merchant geography empty; completion true; each entire upload uses one assumed channel; naive clock treated asUTC. Amounts used in original nominal units, not verified currency conversion.
sparkov_interpretation: Unsupported field sensitivity only. No preferred channel selected; repeated conditions share rows. Not a valid general-purpose accuracy estimate and not a supported native import.
sparkov_missing: No native MCC, exact chip/swipe/online channel, completion status or merchant city/state/zip. Home address is NOT merchant address.
sparkov_population: First100000 rows of fraudTrain.csv; no label sampling. Nonoverlapping10000-row uploads, source timestamps retain seconds.
